mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner.*, ROWNUM rn FROM ( SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, MEM.MBR_NM, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM BOARD_CARTEGORY BDC JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON BDC.BRD_CTGRY = C.CODE_VALUE WHERE BDC.BRD_CODE = BD.BRD_CODE AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT') AS brdCodeName, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM NOTICE N JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON N.NOTICE_TYPE = C.CODE_VALUE WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'NOTPE') AS noticeTypeName, (SELECT Q.QNA_STATUS FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaStatus, (SELECT Q.QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaCtgry,
(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'QNACT' AND CODE_VALUE = (SELECT QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA WHERE BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) ) AS qnaCtgryNm,
NULL AS qnaCtgryNm,
(SELECT Q.QNA_ANSWERED_AT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaAnsweredAt, (SELECT F.FAQ_CTGRY FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS faqCtgry,
(SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_GROUP = 'FAQCT' AND C.CODE_VALUE = (SELECT F.FAQ_CTGRY FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) ) AS faqCtgryNm
NULL AS faqCtgryNm
FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD WHERE BD.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BD.BRD_CODE = #{detailSearch.brdCode}
AND (BD.BRD_END_DTM IS NULL OR BD.BRD_END_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND (
BD.BRD_TITL_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.brdTitlNm} || '%'
OR BD.BRD_CONT LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.brdCont} || '%'
)
AND BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM >= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.brdPblsDtmStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM <= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.brdPblsDtmEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND F.FAQ_CTGRY = #{detailSearch.faqCtgry} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND Q.QNA_CTGRY = #{detailSearch.qnaCtgry} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND Q.QNA_STATUS = #{detailSearch.qnaStatus} )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '002' THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '003' THEN 2 WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '001' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM DESC
) inner WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex} ) WHERE rn >= #{firstRecordIndex}

SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT' AND CODE_VALUE = BD.BRD_CODE) AS BRD_CODE_NAME, (SELECT Q.QNA_STATUS FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_STATUS, (SELECT Q.QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_CTGRY, (SELECT Q.QNA_CONT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_CONT, (SELECT Q.ANSWER_CONT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS ANSWER_CONT, (SELECT Q.QNA_ANSWERED_AT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_ANSWERED_AT, (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS noticeType, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM NOTICE N JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON N.NOTICE_TYPE = C.CODE_VALUE WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'NOTPE') AS noticeTypeName, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'QNA_STATUS' AND CODE_VALUE = (SELECT QNA_STATUS FROM QNA WHERE BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO)) AS QNA_STATUS_NAME, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'QNA_CTGRY' AND CODE_VALUE = (SELECT QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA WHERE BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO)) AS QNA_CTGRY_NAME, (SELECT F.FAQ_CTGRY FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_CTGRY, (SELECT F.FAQ_CNT FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_CNT, (SELECT F.FAQ_YN FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_YN FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD WHERE BD.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_FAQ_ID.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO FAQ ( FAQ_ID, BRD_NO, FAQ_CTGRY, FAQ_CTGRY_GRP_CD ) VALUES ( #{faqId}, #{brdNo}, #{faqCtgry}, 'FAQCT' )

SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_QNA_ID.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QNA ( QNA_ID, BRD_NO, QNA_CTGRY, ANSWER_CONT, QNA_STATUS, QNA_ANSWERED_AT, MBR_CD, ANSWER_ADMIN_ID, QNA_CTGRY_GRP_CD, QNA_STATUS_GRP_CD, QNA_YN_GRP_CD ) VALUES ( #{qnaId}, #{brdNo}, #{qnaCtgry}, #{answerCont}, #{qnaStatus}, #{qnaAnsweredAt}, #{mbrCd}, #{answerAdminId}, 'QNACT', 'QNAST', 'YNFG' )
INSERT INTO NOTICE ( NOTICE_NO, NOTICE_TYPE, NOTICE_TYPE_GRP_CD ) VALUES ( #{brdNo}, #{noticeType}, 'NOTPE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE QNA SET ANSWER_CONT = #{answerCont}, QNA_STATUS = #{qnaStatus}, QNA_ANSWERED_AT = SYSDATE, ANSWER_ADMIN_ID = #{answerAdminId} WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
